criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Issue
categories.definition: Queries related to ordering, receiving, activating, or reactivating physical or virtual cards.

categories.name: Card Usage Issue
categories.definition: Queries related to using cards for transactions, cash withdrawals, contactless payments, or ATM issues.

categories.name: Refund Request
categories.definition: Queries related to refunds for transactions or products.

categories.name: Transfer Issue
categories.definition: Queries related to transferring money, failed transfers, pending transfers, or incorrect transfers.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Queries related to proving identity, verifying identity for transactions, or identity checks.

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Queries related to closing or deleting accounts due to dissatisfaction with service.

categories.name: Fee Inquiry
categories.definition: Queries related to fees for transactions, withdrawals, transfers, or card usage.

categories.name: Top-Up Assistance
categories.definition: Queries related to topping up accounts, top-up charges, or issues with top-up not reflecting in balance.

categories.name: Security Concern
categories.definition: Queries related to stolen cards, unauthorized payments, freezing cards, or suspicious activities.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Queries related to exchanging currencies, fees for currency exchange, or currency support.

categories.name: Card Type Inquiry
categories.definition: Queries related to types of cards supported (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) or obtaining specific types of cards.

categories.name: PIN Assistance
categories.definition: Queries related to PIN issues, changing PINs, unblocking PINs, or PIN delivery.

categories.name: ATM Assistance
categories.definition: Queries related to ATM locations, ATM usage, changing PIN at ATMs, or ATM card retention.

categories.name: Contactless Payment Issue
categories.definition: Queries related to contactless payment failures, contactless not working, or contactless payment restrictions.

categories.name: Card Payment Dispute
categories.definition: Queries related to disputing card payments, unrecognized transactions, or duplicate charges.

categories.name: Card Activation
categories.definition: Queries related to activating new cards, reactivating cards, or card activation process.

categories.name: Lost or Stolen Card
categories.definition: Queries related to lost or stolen cards, reporting lost cards, or preventing unauthorized card usage.

categories.name: Card Decline Issue
categories.definition: Queries related to card declines, declined payments, or declined transactions.

categories.name: Physical Card Request
categories.definition: Queries related to ordering additional physical cards or requesting spare physical cards.

categories.name: Virtual Card Request
categories.definition: Queries related to ordering virtual cards, obtaining disposable virtual cards, or virtual card delivery.

categories.name: Transfer Time Inquiry
categories.definition: Queries related to transfer times, pending transfers, or delays in fund availability.

categories.name: Account Information Update
categories.definition: Queries related to updating personal details, changing addresses, or editing account information.

categories.name: Top-Up Limit Inquiry
categories.definition: Queries related to top-up limits, setting top-up limits, or top-up restrictions.

categories.name: Card Fee Dispute
categories.definition: Queries related to disputing card fees, extra charges, or fee explanations.

categories.name: Card Freeze Request
categories.definition: Queries related to freezing cards, blocking cards, or preventing further card usage.

categories.name: Card Replacement Request
categories.definition: Queries related to replacing expired cards, lost cards, or damaged cards.

categories.name: Card Refund Inquiry
categories.definition: Queries related to refund processing, missing refunds, or refund delays.

categories.name: Card Security Concern
categories.definition: Queries related to card security, unauthorized card usage, or suspicious transactions.

categories.name: Card Activation Process
categories.definition: Queries related to the process of activating new cards, card activation steps, or activation assistance.

categories.name: Card Verification Process
categories.definition: Queries related to the process of verifying identity for transactions, identity verification steps, or verification requirements.

categories.name: Card Top-Up Process
categories.definition: Queries related to the process of topping up accounts, top-up methods, or top-up instructions.
